description: Read the exact saved default voice for an owned actorId and actorVersion. Free; no synthesis, does not change any selection, and returns absence explicitly and no provider access token. Use soclo_hosted_voices autoload for the exact saved actorVoice carrier accepted by selectedInput.voices in host plan import; MAIN revalidates it.

actorId.description: The owned actor id, from soclo_actors_list.

actorVersion.description: The owned actor’s current actorVersion, from soclo_actors_list.

name: soclo_actors_voice
title: Read an actor’s saved voice
